searchText: I'm trying to understand how to implement the helper function `validate_inclusion_lists` https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/4003/files#diff-26426b9b899404021b0ddbc114d42e93a98ebf34b93b4d2b7c8175180599b6a2R32-R41 in the case where some transactions from the IL arent included in the payload, it seems like the cl will need to make an engine api request in the payload to verify transaction validity? It's in the engine api as defined here: https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/pull/609 if new payload returned something like `INVALID_INCLUSION_LIST`, you would flag the block and the attesters would vote for its parent block subsequently

excerpts.author: 0xunclebill
excerpts.content:
I'm trying to understand how to implement the helper function `validate_inclusion_lists`

https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/4003/files#diff-26426b9b899404021b0ddbc114d42e93a98ebf34b93b4d2b7c8175180599b6a2R32-R41
 
in the case where some transactions from the IL arent included in the payload, it seems like the cl will need to make an engine api request in the payload to verify transaction validity?

excerpts.author: terencechain
excerpts.content:
It's in the engine api as defined here: https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/pull/609
if new payload returned something like `INVALID_INCLUSION_LIST`, you would flag the block and the attesters would vote for its parent block subsequently
